notes: Published as decider-2b-vision_fp16-int8vocab.litertlm (the lane's name decider-2b-vision_v7c.litertlm; content unchanged) in litert-community/decider-2b-vision-LiteRT (Hub commit 6c024e94, 2026-09-29): the Hub LFS sha256 equals the measured file's (72f68360..., 4,498,201,472 B). Digest from the lane's bundle record (results/bundle_r4_v7c.json) of the file the harness loaded (out/bundle_r4/v7c/decider-2b-vision_v7c.litertlm). Harness: litertlm-convert decider2bv_work round 6, scripts/r6_bench_row.py through LiteRT-LM 0.17.1 (PyPI, Python API): Engine(bundle, backend, vision_backend = the same, max_num_tokens=4096, max_num_images=1, cache_dir=':nocache' (= litert-lm --cache no), enable_benchmark=True); CPU = Backend.CPU(thread_count=8), GPU = Backend.GPU() for the decoder and the vision encoder (the statically linked WebGPU delegate over Metal); create_conversation(SamplerConfig(top_k=1), max_output_tokens=1); one user message [the published 256x256 PNG of game_pong_atari_up, its text] = 150 prompt tokens including 64 image tokens, one question. One decision per fresh process under /usr/bin/time -l, stdin /dev/null, three processes per cell; the driver waited for other processes above 120 % CPU and re-ran any run where one appeared (originals kept under superseded_runs in results/r6/mac_bench.json / mac_bench_disk.json); GPU processes after a rest of at least 120 s (300 s before the first). Headline fields are the medians of the cache_dir ':nocache' cell: TTFT = in-process wall from sending the message to the first streamed token; prefill tok/s = get_benchmark_info() last_prefill_tokens_per_second; engine_create_s = the Engine constructor wall (the runtime's own init_time_in_second reads about twice it and is kept as init_runtime_s_median). The decode rate over one output token is not a measurement and is not recorded. The warm-cache-folder series of the same row and harness sits in metrics under warm_cache_folder.* because it has the same accelerator x prompt-length identity. Every run answered 'A' = upstream's option. 2026-09-29 02:06-02:49 JST.
quantization: decoder fully connected weights fp16, output head dynamic int8, token embedding int8 (channelwise); vision encoder and adapter fp16; fp32 activation preference declared on the decoder section
